notes: ἀπ᾽ ἀγορᾶς carries the supplied lexical verb when they come under rule 62, the preposition being the predicate's carrier; reading those three words added under rule 86 was rejected because a source token licenses them.

χαλκίων heads on brasen, the word realizing the χαλκ- root, which is the reading rule 104's root-family query gives; heading on vessels remains defensible if vessels is read as a gloss of the lexeme rather than a generic completion.
The variant adding καὶ κλινῶν is not carried by the projection, so no token stands for the ASV's marginal and couches and no rule 97 question arises.
